groups.name: PCI Segmentation — iface_1
groups.description: Host discovery from adapter {iface_1} toward cde_scope, non_cde_scope, out_of_scope and scope. Requires root or nmap raw-socket capabilities.

items.name: iface_1 -> cde_scope: Host Discovery
items.description: PCI DSS 11.4.5/11.4.6 segmentation check: multi-probe host discovery (ICMP echo/timestamp, TCP SYN/ACK, UDP; no port scan) sent via iface_1 toward CDE (stores/processes/transmits CHD + same-segment systems). Any live host means iface_1's segment can reach that zone: compare with the approved flow matrix.

items.description: PCI DSS 11.4.5/11.4.6 segmentation check: multi-probe host discovery (ICMP echo/timestamp, TCP SYN/ACK, UDP; no port scan) sent via iface_1 toward non-CDE in-scope (connected-to / security-impacting). Any live host means iface_1's segment can reach that zone: compare with the approved flow matrix.

items.description: PCI DSS 11.4.5/11.4.6 segmentation check: multi-probe host discovery (ICMP echo/timestamp, TCP SYN/ACK, UDP; no port scan) sent via iface_1 toward out-of-scope (no CDE access, no security impact).
